qr.prompt: They've moved the goalposts again, haven't they?
qr.promptKo: 또 기준을 바꿨죠, 그렇죠?

options.text: Afraid so. Third time this month.

qr.prompt: I can certainly see the appeal, but I do wonder about the timing.
qr.promptKo: 매력은 충분히 알겠는데 시기가 좀 의문이네요.

options.text: Fair point. Would a staggered launch ease your concerns?
options.ko: 일리 있어요. 단계적 출시면 걱정이 덜하실까요?

options.text: The appeal was rejected last week.

qr.prompt: Oh, brilliant. Another delay. Just what I needed.
qr.promptKo: 아주 훌륭하네. 또 지연이라니. 딱 필요했던 거야.

options.text: I know, the timing couldn't be worse.
options.ko: 그러게, 타이밍이 이보다 나쁠 순 없네.

qr.prompt: Base salary is fixed, but there may be some flexibility elsewhere.
qr.promptKo: 기본급은 고정이지만 다른 데서 유연성이 있을 수 있어요.

options.text: I'm very flexible, I do yoga.
The base is on the ground floor.
Then perhaps we could look at the signing bonus.
options.ko: 그럼 입사 보너스를 검토해 볼 수 있을까요?

qr.prompt: So you're saying customers should just accept it?
qr.promptKo: 그러니까 고객이 그냥 받아들여야 한다는 겁니까?

options.text: That's not what I said, and I'd push back on that framing.
options.ko: 그렇게 말하지 않았고, 그 프레임엔 반박하겠습니다.

qr.prompt: Where would you draw the line?
qr.promptKo: 어디에 선을 긋겠어요?

options.text: At amplification, rather than speech itself.

qr.prompt: We're not going to settle this over dinner, are we?
qr.promptKo: 저녁 먹으면서 결판낼 건 아니잖아, 그렇지?

qr.prompt: What's stopping a big player from copying you?
qr.promptKo: 대기업이 따라 하지 못하게 하는 건 뭐죠?

options.text: Three years of data nobody else has.
The copier is out of paper.

qr.prompt: He's left me on read for five days.
qr.promptKo: 5일째 읽씹당했어.

options.text: Ugh. Silence like that usually speaks for itself.
options.ko: 에휴. 그런 침묵은 보통 그 자체가 답이야.

options.text: Five days is a long holiday.

qr.prompt: Should I post on the status page now or wait?
qr.promptKo: 상태 페이지에 지금 올릴까요, 기다릴까요?

options.text: The post office closes at five.
Now. A vague update beats silence.

qr.prompt: Do you want the comfortable version or the useful one?
qr.promptKo: 편한 버전 원해요, 쓸모 있는 버전 원해요?

options.text: The useful one, please, however much it stings.
Version two is out next week.

qr.prompt: I don't believe we've been introduced.
qr.promptKo: 인사를 못 나눈 것 같네요.

options.text: We haven't. I'm Daniel, with the foundation.

qr.prompt: Could you just tweak the numbers a little?
qr.promptKo: 숫자를 조금만 손봐 줄 수 있어?

options.text: The numbers are on page two.
I'm not comfortable doing that, but I can help explain them.
options.ko: 그건 불편하지만 설명하는 건 도울 수 있어.

qr.prompt: Isn't it premature to promote her?
qr.promptKo: 그녀를 승진시키기엔 이르지 않나요?

options.text: Not when she's been doing the job for six months.
options.ko: 6개월째 그 일을 하고 있는데 이르진 않죠.

qr.prompt: What would falsify your theory?
qr.promptKo: 무엇이 당신 이론을 반증할까요?

options.text: My theory is in the library.
Similar cities showing no change at all.
options.ko: 비슷한 도시에서 아무 변화가 없는 것이요.

qr.prompt: Great to see you again, Michelle!
qr.promptKo: 다시 만나서 반가워요, 미셸!

options.text: I'll see you again next week.

qr.prompt: He just feels like a better culture fit.
qr.promptKo: 그 사람이 그냥 문화적으로 더 잘 맞는 느낌이에요.

options.text: Can I gently push on that? Let's look at the scorecard.

qr.prompt: Bold words from someone whose team hasn't won away all year.
qr.promptKo: 올해 원정에서 한 번도 못 이긴 팀 팬치고는 말이 세네.

options.text: Ouch. Fair, but at least we're consistent.

qr.prompt: Why spend so much on courses?
qr.promptKo: 왜 강의에 그렇게 많이 써?

options.text: The course was a golf course.
An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
options.ko: 지식에 대한 투자가 최고의 이자를 낳으니까.

qr.prompt: Be brutally honest. What should I stop doing?
qr.promptKo: 가차 없이 솔직하게 말해 줘요. 내가 뭘 그만둬야 해요?

options.text: Since you asked, the midnight emails.
I'm always honest about the weather.

qr.prompt: So how did we end up here?
qr.promptKo: 그래서 어쩌다 이렇게 됐죠?

options.text: In hindsight, my forecasts were too rosy, and I own that.
options.ko: 지나고 보니 제 전망이 너무 장밋빛이었고, 제 책임이에요.

qr.prompt: It's hard to say at this stage.
qr.promptKo: 지금 단계에선 말하기 어렵네요.

options.text: Understood. If you had to guess, which way would you lean?

qr.prompt: Would you describe the talks as a failure?
qr.promptKo: 회담을 실패라고 보십니까?

options.text: I'd describe them as frank and substantive.
I failed my driving test once.

qr.prompt: Didn't you say the feature would definitely work?
qr.promptKo: 그 기능이 무조건 될 거라고 하지 않았어요?

options.text: I did, and I stand corrected.

lines.text: The client's latest email asks for the dashboard in three languages, with no change to the deadline or the budget.
lines.ko: 고객의 최신 메일은 마감과 예산은 그대로 두고 대시보드를 3개 언어로 해 달래요.

lines.text: That's the fourth expansion since we signed. If we keep absorbing it, we'll lose money on the whole account.
lines.ko: 계약 후 네 번째 확장이에요. 계속 떠안으면 이 고객 전체에서 손해를 볼 거예요.

lines.text: They're our biggest client, though. I'd rather not start a fight we can't afford to lose.
lines.ko: 그래도 최대 고객이에요. 질 수 없는 싸움은 시작하고 싶지 않아요.

lines.text: Then let's not fight. Let's propose a simple change-request process and price each extra item transparently.
lines.ko: 그럼 싸우지 말죠. 간단한 변경 요청 절차를 제안하고 추가 항목마다 투명하게 가격을 매기죠.

questions.q: What does the client want now?
What worries the second speaker?
What do they decide to propose?

lines.text: We've gone to the top of the salary band, so I'm afraid the base really can't move any further.
lines.ko: 연봉 범위 최상단까지 갔으니 유감이지만 기본급은 더 못 올려요.

lines.text: I understand. My hesitation is that another company is offering roughly twelve percent more in total.
lines.ko: 이해해요. 망설이는 이유는 다른 회사가 총액으로 12퍼센트쯤 더 준다는 거예요.

lines.text: We could add a signing bonus and bring the first equity grant forward by six months.
lines.ko: 입사 보너스를 더하고 첫 지분 부여를 6개월 앞당길 수 있어요.

lines.text: If the first year matches the other offer, you'll have my signature by Friday.
lines.ko: 첫해가 다른 제안과 맞으면 금요일까지 서명할게요.

questions.q: Why can't the base salary go higher?
options: It's at the top of the band.

questions.q: How much more is the other offer?
What does the company offer instead?
options: A signing bonus and earlier equity

lines.text: Card payments in Europe have been failing for twenty minutes, and the error rate is still going up.
lines.ko: 유럽 카드 결제가 20분째 실패하고 있고 오류율은 계속 오르고 있어요.

lines.text: Roll back last night's release immediately. We can work out the root cause once customers can pay again.
lines.ko: 어젯밤 배포를 즉시 롤백해요. 원인은 고객이 다시 결제할 수 있게 되면 찾으면 돼요.

lines.text: Rolling back now. What about the status page? We don't know the cause yet.
lines.ko: 지금 롤백 중이에요. 상태 페이지는요? 아직 원인을 몰라요.

lines.text: Post something now and update every thirty minutes. Silence is worse than saying we're investigating.
lines.ko: 지금 뭐라도 올리고 30분마다 업데이트해요. 조사 중이라고 말하는 것보다 침묵이 더 나빠요.

questions.q: What is failing?
What is the first action?
How often will they update the status page?

lines.text: The figures in the final report don't match the raw data, and I can't find any record of a correction.
lines.ko: 최종 보고서 수치가 원자료와 맞지 않고 수정 기록도 찾을 수가 없어요.

lines.text: Before you assume the worst, check whether a revised dataset was used. It happens more often than you'd think.
lines.ko: 최악을 가정하기 전에 수정된 데이터셋이 쓰였는지 확인해요. 생각보다 자주 있는 일이에요.

lines.text: I've checked twice, and only one person had editing access on the day the numbers changed.
lines.ko: 두 번 확인했고, 숫자가 바뀐 날 편집 권한이 있던 사람은 한 명뿐이었어요.

lines.text: Then write down everything you found, don't confront him, and go to compliance through the formal process.
lines.ko: 그럼 찾은 걸 전부 적고, 그 사람과 대면하지 말고, 공식 절차로 준법감시팀에 가요.

questions.q: What doesn't match?
options: The report and the raw data

questions.q: What does the senior colleague suggest checking first?
options: Whether a revised dataset was used

questions.q: What should the speaker avoid?

lines.text: Straight to it: we have five months of cash, and the only offer on the table values us below our last round.
lines.ko: 바로 말하면, 현금이 5개월 치 남았고 유일한 제안은 지난 라운드보다 낮게 평가해요.

lines.text: That's a blow. Why are we only hearing about this now?
lines.ko: 타격이 크네요. 왜 이제야 듣는 거죠?

lines.text: Because I was too optimistic about two enterprise deals, which have now slipped into next year. That's on me.
lines.ko: 기업 거래 두 건을 너무 낙관했는데 내년으로 밀렸어요. 제 책임이에요.

lines.text: I appreciate the candor. If the round buys enough time for those deals to close, I'd support it.
lines.ko: 솔직해서 고마워요. 그 거래들이 성사될 시간을 벌 수 있다면 지지할게요.

questions.q: How much cash does the company have left?
What does the founder admit?
options: Being too optimistic about two deals

questions.q: Under what condition will the investor support the round?
options: If costs are cut in half
If it buys time for the deals to close

lines.text: There's a small shadow on the scan. In all honesty, it's ambiguous, and it may well be nothing at all.
lines.ko: 영상에 작은 음영이 있어요. 솔직히 애매하고, 아무것도 아닐 가능성도 충분해요.

lines.text: Could you walk me through the possibilities, from most to least likely?
lines.ko: 가능성을 가장 높은 것부터 차근차근 알려 주시겠어요?

lines.text: Most likely a harmless cyst. Less likely, something we'd want to catch early. A biopsy would give us a definite answer.
lines.ko: 가장 가능성 높은 건 무해한 낭종이에요. 가능성은 낮지만 일찍 잡아야 할 것일 수도 있고요. 조직 검사로 확실한 답을 얻을 수 있어요.

lines.text: Then let's do it. I'd much rather know than spend weeks wondering.
lines.ko: 그럼 해요. 몇 주씩 궁금해하느니 아는 게 훨씬 나아요.

questions.q: How does the doctor describe the scan?
What is the most likely explanation?
What does the patient decide?

lines.text: I'd lean towards James. There's just something about him that feels like a natural fit for the team.
lines.ko: 저는 제임스 쪽이에요. 팀에 자연스럽게 맞는 뭔가가 있어요.

lines.text: Can I gently challenge that? 'Natural fit' sometimes just means 'reminds us of ourselves'.
lines.ko: 살짝 반론해도 될까요? '자연스럽게 맞는다'는 건 때로 '우리와 닮았다'는 뜻일 뿐이에요.

lines.text: On the scorecard we agreed on, Amina was ahead on every technical question and tied on communication.
lines.ko: 우리가 합의한 평가표에선 아미나가 모든 기술 질문에서 앞섰고 의사소통은 동점이었어요.

lines.text: That's a fair challenge. Let's decide on the criteria we set, not on gut feeling.
lines.ko: 타당한 반론이에요. 직감 말고 우리가 정한 기준으로 결정하죠.

questions.q: Why does the first speaker prefer James?
options: He seems like a natural fit

questions.q: What does the second speaker warn about?
How did Amina do on communication?

lines.text: Before we begin, I owe the team a correction. Last week I said the drop in sign-ups was seasonal.
lines.ko: 시작 전에 팀에 정정할 게 있어요. 지난주 가입 감소가 계절적이라고 했죠.

lines.text: After digging into the data, I was wrong. The decline began the day we redesigned the sign-up form.
lines.ko: 데이터를 파 보니 제가 틀렸어요. 감소는 가입 양식을 바꾼 날 시작됐어요.

lines.text: Thanks for saying that openly. It saves us chasing the wrong problem for a month.
lines.ko: 공개적으로 말해 줘서 고마워요. 엉뚱한 문제를 한 달 쫓는 걸 막아 줬네요.

lines.text: My suggestion is to restore the old form for half of new visitors and compare results for two weeks.
lines.ko: 신규 방문자 절반에게 예전 양식을 되돌려 주고 2주간 결과를 비교하는 걸 제안해요.

questions.q: What did the speaker claim last week?
What actually caused the decline?
What does the speaker propose?
options: Testing the old form with half of visitors

lines.text: Between two and three this morning, roughly eight percent of card payments in Europe failed after a faulty configuration change.
lines.ko: 오늘 새벽 2시에서 3시 사이, 잘못된 설정 변경 이후 유럽 카드 결제의 약 8퍼센트가 실패했습니다.

lines.text: We rolled the change back within forty minutes, and no customer data was exposed or lost.
lines.ko: 40분 안에 변경을 되돌렸고 고객 데이터의 노출이나 손실은 없었습니다.

lines.text: Going forward, every configuration change will require a second reviewer and a staged rollout.
lines.ko: 앞으로 모든 설정 변경에는 두 번째 검토자와 단계적 배포가 필요합니다.

questions.q: What percentage of payments failed?
How quickly was the change rolled back?
What will change going forward?
options: A second reviewer and staged rollouts

lines.text: Today's discussions were frank and, at times, difficult, which is to be expected given the issues on the table.
lines.ko: 오늘 논의는 솔직했고 때로는 어려웠는데, 테이블에 놓인 사안을 고려하면 예상된 일입니다.

lines.text: We have not reached an agreement, but both delegations have committed to meet again within thirty days.
lines.ko: 합의에 이르지는 못했지만 양측 대표단은 30일 이내에 다시 만나기로 약속했습니다.

lines.text: Given where we began this morning, I would characterize that as modest but meaningful progress.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침의 출발점을 생각하면 저는 그것을 작지만 의미 있는 진전이라고 규정하겠습니다.

questions.q: How were the talks described?
What did both sides commit to?
How does the speaker characterize the outcome?

lines.text: Let me be clear that I'm not opposed to new housing; this town desperately needs it.
lines.ko: 분명히 말씀드리면 저는 새 주택에 반대하지 않습니다. 이 도시는 그게 절실해요.

lines.text: My objection is that the plan adds four hundred homes without a single additional school place or doctor's surgery.
lines.ko: 제 반대는 이 계획이 주택 400호를 늘리면서 학교 정원도 병원도 하나 늘리지 않는다는 점입니다.

lines.text: I'd urge the council to approve it only on condition that the new school is built before the first residents move in.
lines.ko: 첫 입주민이 들어오기 전에 새 학교가 지어진다는 조건으로만 승인하도록 시의회에 촉구합니다.

questions.q: What is the speaker's view on new housing?
What is missing from the plan?
options: School places and a doctor's surgery

questions.q: What condition does the speaker want?
options: The school built before residents move in

lines.text: Welcome back to Second Thoughts, the show where we take popular ideas and poke them until something interesting falls out.
lines.ko: 세컨드 소츠에 다시 오신 걸 환영해요. 인기 있는 생각을 흥미로운 게 떨어질 때까지 찔러 보는 쇼죠.

lines.text: Today's target is hustle culture: the belief that success requires sacrificing sleep, weekends, and most of your twenties.
lines.ko: 오늘의 표적은 '갈아 넣기' 문화예요. 성공하려면 잠, 주말, 20대 대부분을 희생해야 한다는 믿음이죠.

lines.text: My co-host thinks it's mostly marketing. I think it's more complicated than that, and we'll argue about it for the next forty minutes.
lines.ko: 제 공동 진행자는 그게 대부분 마케팅이라고 봐요. 저는 그보다 복잡하다고 보고, 앞으로 40분간 그걸로 논쟁할 거예요.

questions.q: What does the show do?
What is today's topic?
What does the co-host believe?

lines.text: For those who don't know me, I'm the groom's older brother, which means I've had three decades to gather material.
lines.ko: 저를 모르시는 분들을 위해, 신랑의 형입니다. 30년간 소재를 모았다는 뜻이죠.

lines.text: I've been asked to keep it clean, so you'll be relieved to hear this will be a very short speech.
lines.ko: 깨끗하게 하라는 부탁을 받았으니, 아주 짧은 축사라는 소식에 안도하실 거예요.

lines.text: In all seriousness, I've never seen him calmer or happier than he is with Sarah. Please raise your glasses to them both.
lines.ko: 농담은 그만하고, 사라와 함께일 때만큼 동생이 차분하고 행복한 걸 본 적이 없어요. 두 사람을 위해 잔을 들어 주세요.

questions.q: Who is the speaker?
Why will the speech be short?
options: He was asked to keep it clean.

questions.q: What is the serious message?
options: The groom is happiest with Sarah

lines.text: Training is always the easiest line to cut, precisely because the damage doesn't show up for a year or more.
lines.ko: 교육비는 늘 가장 쉽게 깎이는 항목입니다. 피해가 1년 이상 지나야 드러나기 때문이죠.

lines.text: Benjamin Franklin put it well: an investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
lines.ko: 벤저민 프랭클린이 잘 표현했죠. 지식에 대한 투자가 최고의 이자를 낳는다고.

lines.text: If we cut it now, we'll pay recruiters roughly twice as much next year to buy the skills we chose not to grow.
lines.ko: 지금 깎으면 내년에 우리가 키우지 않기로 한 역량을 사느라 헤드헌터에게 대략 두 배를 낼 겁니다.

questions.q: Why is training easy to cut?
Who does the speaker quote?
What will happen if training is cut?
options: Hiring will cost about twice as much

lines.text: Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country. Kennedy said that in nineteen sixty-one.
lines.ko: 국가가 당신을 위해 무엇을 할지 묻지 말고 당신이 국가를 위해 무엇을 할지 물으라. 케네디가 1961년에 한 말입니다.

lines.text: Sixty years later, it still works, because it flips the same words around and makes you think twice.
lines.ko: 60년이 지나도 여전히 통하는 건, 같은 단어를 뒤집어 다시 생각하게 만들기 때문이죠.

lines.text: This morning, three hundred of you chose to answer that question by showing up. Thank you, and let's get to work.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침 여러분 300명이 나타나는 것으로 그 질문에 답하기로 하셨습니다. 감사하고, 일을 시작합시다.

questions.q: When did Kennedy say the quote?
Why does the quote still work?
options: It flips the same words around

questions.q: How many volunteers came?

lines.text: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times. Dickens opens with a contradiction and refuses to resolve it.
lines.ko: 최고의 시절이자 최악의 시절이었다. 디킨스는 모순으로 시작하고 그걸 해소하지 않습니다.

lines.text: That refusal is the point: most eras, and most lives, contain both at once.
lines.ko: 그 거부가 핵심입니다. 대부분의 시대와 삶은 둘 다를 동시에 품고 있으니까요.

lines.text: For next week, write one paragraph describing your own year in a way that holds two opposite truths together.
lines.ko: 다음 주까지 두 가지 상반된 진실을 함께 담아 자신의 한 해를 묘사하는 문단 하나를 써 오세요.

questions.q: How does Dickens open the novel?
According to the speaker, what do most lives contain?
questions.qKo: 화자에 따르면 대부분의 삶은 무엇을 품나요?
options: Both good and bad at once

questions.q: What is the homework?
options: Write one paragraph about your year
